asr.full_text: Hello everyone and welcome back to WS Cube Tech In today's video, Google has cancelled the feature support for robots.txt.noindex This is the latest news released by Google They told for robots.txt they are cancelling the support There will be no support for robots.txt So, we will see the alternatives of this feature will be not available so we are going to discuss these things in this particular video We will understand what are the alternatives or how we can implement that if they don't work So this is all about this video But Guys before starting this video I have a comment here which is full in Hindi They asked me a question here, I want to answer it first This person has asked how much is the ratio of dofollow and nofollow backlinks Meaning, if there are 10 dofollow backlinks then we have to make nofollow backlinks to appear a good backlink profile so i will tell one thing in the starting that is your backlinks, back-link of web page or back-link of website should be basically natural sometimes you try to make them a natural i.e. you try to make them natural they are not natural backlink, but I want it to look natural. So try to create natural backlink not appear as natural one. So keep this thing in your mind. Then I will tell you all my work on many projects. as much work I have done on so much project according to that my experience is that 60 to 40 a good ratio this ratio will be 60 to 35 or 70 to 30 means if you are making 70 backlinks of dofollow then you should have 30 backlinks of Dofollow. If you feel that from the point of view of good ranking because Google does not follow it, so let's go from the point of view of good ranking for any backlinks it will become 100% that if the backlinks are made by Dofollow, then what will happen, then this is also not a good strategy. What does Google expect because you will you are using natural link building strategy But you forced them to make your link about do follow backlinks only You have to keep in mind this that you don't have to make backlinks with same style It must have a good mix the mix here I had some comments so from point of view of that I gave the answer and if you don't know difference between do follow backlink and no follow backlinks then the video for that I will give the link here in the I button so from there you can see your basics will be stronger so you so the answer you got from this question so now let us start the video and come back to our topiie here we can see like i have written a statement that google announced that google bot will no longer obey a TXT directive related to indexing after September 1 2019 you got the deadline as the deadline is September 1 2019 so, the Googlebot's directive is related to the indexing where you write the syntax of no-index in robots.txt file that will not work... and you get a deadline of 21Sept 2019 and if you don still don't understand this here is the screenshot of the twitter account of google webmaster in which they mentioned today we are saying goodbye to undocumented and unsupported rules in robots.txt if you were relying on these rules learn about your options in your blog post so you can go on their blog post and you which they've mentioned the methods how they are closing index option. And the robot.txt's option. And so on. It will be given there, and I will try to do a video on it. If you are confused that what's this in this, then what is this NOindex? So,we come here and check what is this, the NOindex will stop the page showing in search and disallow will be stopped and being crawled We write syntax syntax in 2 ways. If you are following my videos then you must be knowing I have made videos on robot.txt. In which I had also told you how to write syntax. Here we write the syntax of disallow. This is our webpage. Ok, so this is the webpage, to which we don't want to be crawl so we disallow it and page which we don't want to show in the result pages we will show that in the no index so now you don't have this option and previously both of them were used simultaneously that means you use the no index in one robot.txt file and you used the disallow too. Now which are the options as the support has stopped from here, So I have written some alternates here that you can find in their blog also the google blog also. So, it is mentioned here as 5 ways to control indexing. From these what you can do? No Indexed Robot Meta Tag, you do. No indexing robot, metatags. So now in here in robot.txt, not only in metatags you can implement it, there are 404 and 410 HTTP status codes. These basically are related to page not found. So you can use them. Because of which you won't find page there. So basically, is not indexed or it will not crawl. Then you can do password protection by disallow-in-robot-txt as we have seen syntax in this place. You can do this because it is allowed it still work but no index won't work. Then fifth is Search Console Remove URL tool. Search Console has the tool of removing URL by which you can remove the URL normally. Fifth is Search Console Remove URL Tool Search Console has its own tool for removing URLs through which you can normally remove URLs but there your indexing won't happen So, these are five alternatives I always try to come with new updates in my videos See, in SEO once you have learned many basics after that many things changes in time so you need to be updated if you are not, then and for some blog or website you can manage that you are downfall in ranking if you didn't updated those latest updates then you are in loss in this particular video guys my main objective that you can understand this. So, guys, thank you once again for providing us love and support and watching this video and friends, if you have not subscribed to our channel yet, then Please subscribe to our channel, like this video, share and see you in the next video. Till then goodbye.
